Optum Insight • Optum Insight continues to develop and bring AI-enabled solutions to market that enhance services and reduce administrative burden across the health system, including capabilities that streamline clinical documentation and improve payment accuracy and speed, returning more time to clinicians for care. • Optum Insight reported third quarter 2026 revenues of $5.5 billion, an increase of 3% year-over-year. • Third quarter 2026 earnings from operations were $1.3 billion compared to $920 million in the third quarter 2025. The year-over-year improvement was driven by enhanced product offerings and operational efficiencies. Optum Rx • Optum Rx continues to advance transparent pharmacy pricing while broadening the clinically integrated pharmacy services that patients depend on. • Optum Rx’s third quarter 2026 revenues were $39.9 billion compared to $39.7 billion in the third quarter 2025. • Earnings from operations for the third quarter 2026 were $1.7 billion compared to $1.5 billion in the third quarter 2025, reflecting continued adoption of biosimilars and operational improvements. Adjusted scripts were 393 million compared to 414 million in the year ago quarter due to membership declines within UnitedHealthcare and other customers. 7 About UnitedHealth Group UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH) is a healthcare and well-being company with a mission to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone through two distinct and complementary businesses. Optum delivers care aided by technology and data, empowering people, partners and providers with the guidance and tools they need to achieve better health. UnitedHealthcare offers a full range of health benefits, enabling affordable coverage, simplifying the healthcare experience and delivering access to high-quality care. Visit UnitedHealth Group at www.unitedhealthgroup.com and follow UnitedHealth Group on LinkedIn.
